test_title: PYST 23: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 28 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the option that rectifies the incorrectly spelt underlined word.

The Swiss __entrepreneure__ has pulled the plug on any further investment in the firm.
solution:
The correct answer is '**entrepreneur**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **incorrect **spelling in the sentence is "**entrepreneure**".
 
• The **correct **spelling is "**entrepreneur**".
 
• "**Entrepreneur**" means a person who organizes and operates a business or businesses, taking on greater than normal financial risks in order to do so. (उद्यमी)
 
 
• **Example**: The young **entrepreneur **launched her tech startup last year, aiming to revolutionize the way we use social media.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct spelling is **entrepreneur**.

Therefore, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".

 

**Correct Sentence**: *The Swiss **entrepreneur__ has pulled the plug on any further investment in the firm.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **antepreneure**: This option is incorrect due to misspelling.
 
• **entreperneur**: This option is incorrect due to misspelling.
 
• **entreprenur**: This option is incorrect due to misspelling.
